biggest_catch: This $100 rate is a LIMITED-TIME 2x boost over the standard $50 referral incentive - it can end at any time once referral bonus funds are exhausted, so the amount is only as durable as the promo.
catches: Referrer earns $100 per qualifying referral during the limited-time 2x promotion (double the standard $50 incentive); offer may end at any time once funds are exhausted.
Cap: $100 max referral bonus per referred member; $500 max total referral bonuses per calendar year.
Referrer must be an existing, active Cal Coast member in good standing, 18+.

Friend must: be a new Cal Coast member; pay a one-time $5 membership fee; open savings + checking with eStatements; maintain at least $50 in either account until the bonus is paid; enroll in Digital Banking, Bill Pay, or Direct Deposit.
Bonuses paid to the savings account within 3 business days after qualifications are met.
Bonuses considered interest, subject to tax, reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Cannot be combined with other offers; branch employees ineligible; membership and credit subject to approval.
